name: AniList
author: Chronicle Contributors
description: Anime series, season, episode and film metadata from AniList: titles in English, romaji and native, synopses, genres, tags, studios, voice cast, staff, ratings and artwork. No API key or account required.
fixMatchHint: Enter an AniList ID (16498), an AniList URL (https://anilist.co/anime/16498), a MyAnimeList ID prefixed with mal: (mal:16498), or a MyAnimeList URL.

background_tasks.description: Looks up AniList metadata for anime and anime movies that have not been enriched by AniList yet.
Re-fetches all AniList metadata to pick up new episodes, season changes, scores and artwork.
